verification_scope: independent read-only scoring/lineage audit; writes restricted to this evidence and artifact provenance

baseline.product_hash_basis: git show de0725faaf8ca9d885078767b903152697d50703:<path>; current product files may be edited after the run

independent_method.scoring: Compare each recorded kind/action/arguments and typed service status to the already-frozen service_expected. MODEL_TIMEOUT rows remain timeout; never infer success from HTTP 200.
independent_method.state_hashes: Parse FlightControlState defaults from the fixed Git blob using Python AST without executing product code; merge context_version=1 and each frozen initial_state; reproduce Python canonical JSON SHA256; compare both recorded state hashes for all 102 rows.
independent_method.source_and_lineage: Hash product blobs from fixed Git commit, hash frozen bench/fixture bytes, and compare all inherited v1 fields by id; no post-result relabeling.
independent_method.inputs_and_labels: Recomputed input, original intent label, normalized service label, complete service label and initial-state semantic hashes independently.

model_metadata.limitation: Before/after observations only; not a cryptographic per-request model pin. Raw metadata files were not supplied to this verifier.

limitations: 修复前服务候选：90/6/6不得标为即将修改产品的修复后准确率；本次未重新请求模型。
Agent编写的102条合成契约，没有独立真人标签或真实飞行真值；accuracy=not_evaluable。
v1为100条建议层，v2为102条服务层且有显式前态和独立服务标签，不能直接合并为同口径A/B。
read_state冻结标签要求实际read_state工具记录；inquiry_03有两次服务状态读取而工具记录0，严格不匹配不等于没有读取状态。
unsafe_action_proposals=1只统计预期非action却给出动作的情形；另有3条预期动作被替换为control_acquire的错误写预览。
68次预览包含4次错误写预览，不等于68次正确动作；确认、写执行、平台调用为0。
6条模型超时保留102分母；总tokens/费用未知，已知usage不能替代完整用量。
每例独立单轮服务/模拟器，仅评首项建议；不评完整多轮确认、取消、恢复、并发或设备效果。
调用数与副作用计数为原报告记录并与行汇总核对；没有独立网络抓包、逐请求模型digest或真机证据。
